entities.name: HisH (Q6A8L2)
observations: Supplied 205-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed Cutibacterium acnes UniProt Q6A8L2, imidazole glycerol phosphate synthase glutaminase subunit.
HisH hydrolyzes glutamine to glutamate and ammonia; ammonia is channeled to HisF in the coupled synthesis of imidazole glycerol phosphate and AICAR.

entities.name: Glutamine hydrolysis
observations: Reaction: L-glutamine + H2O = L-glutamate + NH4(+); HisH catalyzes this hydrolysis as the glutaminase subunit of imidazole glycerol phosphate synthase (EC 3.5.1.2; Rhea RHEA:15889).

entities.name: IGPS coupled reaction
observations: Overall coupled reaction: PRFAR + L-glutamine yields imidazole glycerol phosphate (IGP), AICAR, and L-glutamate; ammonia generated by HisH is channeled to the HisF active site. (EC 4.3.2.10; Rhea RHEA:24793).
